## What

Describe what this pull request changes.

## Why

The problem it solves. Link the issue, e.g. `Closes #123`.

## How to test

Steps a reviewer can follow, the S3 provider you used, and screenshots for UI changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read and signed the [Contributor License Agreement](https://github.com/pagliarinilucas/Cockpit-S3/blob/main/CLA.md) (the CLA Assistant bot asks on your first pull request).
- [ ] `bun run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `bun run test` passes.
- [ ] Permission checks are enforced in the API, not only in the UI.
- [ ] New source files have the SPDX header.
- [ ] If production dependencies changed: I ran `bun run license:audit` and committed `docs/dependency-licenses.md`.
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed.
